name: repo_review_mode
description: aegis-za4f.17.1: review mode of one repository (aegis:reviewMode on aegis:GitRepo: non-author or none). Param repo = 'owner/name', matched EXACTLY against rdfs:label or skos:altLabel; the owner is never discarded, so a fact on another owner's node cannot answer (fail closed). Returns every matching row: the caller treats no rows or conflicting rows as non-author. 64 rows is an overflow sentinel.
